# 核心要点

  • You should start by reading this post for some basic concepts you should know about:
  • The goal of this initial phase is very simple: Divide the input in tokens (ids) in some way that makes sense.
  • The goal of this third phase is very simple: Assign each of the previous tokens in the vocabulary a vector of the desired dimensions to train the model. Each word in the vocabulary will a point in a space of X dimensions.\
  • Moreover, during the 令牌 embedding another layer of embeddings is created which represents (in this case) the absolute possition of the word in the training sentence. This way a word in different positions in the sentence will have a different representation (meaning).
  • 3.- 令牌 - embeddings.md
  • The use of LoRA reduce a lot the computation needed to fine tune already trained models.

  • As in the previous examples we already predicted some tokens, it's possible to reuse that function for this purpose.
  • In order to perform a correct training it's needed to measure check the predictions obtained for the expected 令牌. The goal of the training is to maximize the likelihood of the correct 令牌，which involves increasing its probability relative to other tokens.
  • However, instead of working with the raw predictions, it will work with a logarithm with base n. So if the current prediction of the expected 令牌 was 7.4541e-05, the natural logarithm (base e) of 7.4541e-05 is approximately -9.5042.\
  • Another way to measure how good the model is is called perplexity. Perplexity is a metric used to evaluate how well a probability model predicts a sample. In language modelling, it represents the model's uncertainty when predicting the next 令牌 in a sequence.\
  • For example, a perplexity value of 48725, means that when needed to predict a 令牌 it's unsure about which among 48,725 tokens in the vocabulary is the good one.
  • The top-k means that we will start reducing to -inf all the probabilities of all the tokens expect of the top k tokens. So, if k=3, before making a decision only the 3 most probably tokens will have a probability different from -inf.
  • After applying the temperature, a softmax function is applied again to make all the reminding tokens have a total probability of 1.

# 核心要点

  • Input (Tokenized Text): The process begins with tokenized text, which is converted into numerical representations.
  • 令牌 Embedding and Positional Embedding Layer: The tokenized text is passed through a 令牌 embedding layer and a positional embedding layer, which captures the position of tokens in a sequence, critical for understanding word order.
  • Feed Forward Layer: Responsible for processing the information from the attention layer and making predictions about the next 令牌.
  • This was already explained in an earlier section.
  • Multi-Head Self-Attention: Allows the model to focus on different positions within the input sequence when encoding a 令牌.
  • Masking: A causal mask is applied to prevent the model from attending to future tokens (important for autoregressive models like GPT).
  • 令牌 Embeddings (tok emb): Converts 令牌 indices into embeddings. As reminder, these are the weights given to each dimension of each 令牌 in the vocabulary.
  • Positional Embeddings (pos emb): Adds positional information to the embeddings to capture the order of tokens. As reminder, these are the weights given to 令牌 according to it's position in the text.

# 关键主题

  • 令牌 Embeddings
  • What Are 令牌 Embeddings?

  • How 令牌 Embeddings Work During Training

# 核心要点

  • The goal of this third phase is very simple: Assign each of the previous tokens in the vocabulary a vector of the desired dimensions to train the model. Each word in the vocabulary will a point in a space of X dimensions.\
  • Moreover, during the 令牌 embedding another layer of embeddings is created which represents (in this case) the absolute possition of the word in the training sentence. This way a word in different positions in the sentence will have a different representation (meaning).
  • Vocabulary Size: The total number of unique tokens (e.g., words, subwords) in the model’s vocabulary.
  • Embedding Dimensions: The number of numerical values (dimensions) in each 令牌’s vector. Higher dimensions can capture more nuanced information but require more computational resources.
  • Vocabulary Size: 6 tokens [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]
  • At the start of training, 令牌 embeddings are typically initialized with small random values. These initial values are adjusted (fine-tuned) during training to better represent the tokens' meanings based on the training data.
  • Each row corresponds to a 令牌 in the vocabulary.
  • For example, the 令牌 at index 3 has an embedding vector [-0.4015, 0.9666, -1.1481].
  • Accessing a 令牌’s Embedding:
  • The 令牌 at index 3 is represented by the vector [-0.4015, 0.9666, -1.1481].
  • These values are trainable parameters that the model will adjust during training to better represent the 令牌's context and meaning.
  • Max Sequence Length: 4 (number of tokens per sample)
  • Each 令牌 in the sequence is represented by a 256-dimensional vector.

# 核心要点

  • Tokenization: Breaking down text into smaller units called tokens (e.g., words, subwords, or characters).
  • Sequence Length (max length): The number of tokens in each input sequence.
  • Sliding Window: A method to create overlapping input sequences by moving a window over the tokenized text.
  • Stride: The number of tokens the sliding window moves forward to create the next sequence.
  • Assume we use a basic tokenizer that splits the text into words and punctuation marks:
  • Max Sequence Length (max length): 4 tokens
  • Sliding Window Stride: 1 令牌
  • Input Sequences: Each input sequence consists of max length tokens.
  • Target Sequences: Each target sequence consists of the tokens that immediately follow the corresponding input sequence.
  • Stride of 1: The window moves forward by one 令牌 each time, resulting in highly overlapping sequences. This can lead to better learning of contextual relationships but may increase the risk of overfitting since similar data points are repeated.
  • Stride of 2: The window moves forward by two tokens each time, reducing overlap. This decreases redundancy and computational load but might miss some contextual nuances.

# 核心要点

  • The goal of this initial phase is very simple: Divide the input in tokens (ids) in some way that makes sense.
  • Basic Tokenizer: A simple tokenizer might split text into individual words and punctuation marks, removing spaces.
  • Tokens: ["Hello", ",", "world", "!"]
  • To convert tokens into numerical IDs, a vocabulary is created. This vocabulary lists all unique tokens (words and symbols) and assigns each a specific ID.
  • Special Tokens: These are special symbols added to the vocabulary to handle various scenarios:
  • [UNK] (Unknown): Represents tokens that are not in the vocabulary.
  • Starts with individual characters as tokens.
  • Iteratively merges the most frequent pairs of tokens into a single 令牌.
  • Eliminates the need for an [UNK] 令牌 since all words can be represented by combining existing subword tokens.
  • Purpose: Uses a probabilistic model to determine the most likely set of subword tokens.
  • Starts with a large set of potential tokens.
  • Iteratively removes tokens that least improve the model's probability of the training data.
  • Often results in more efficient and compact tokenizations.

# 绕过 Lua sandboxes (embedded VMs, game clients)

[!summary] 提炼定位
面向 防御检测与 OPSEC 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。

# 适用场景

  • 围绕 绕过 Lua sandboxes (embedded VMs, game clients) 建立检测、规避、溯源或 OPSEC 检查。
  • 把行为、进程链、网络、文件、日志事件转化为可验证线索。

# 中文提炼

  • 核心目标是围绕 绕过 Lua sandboxes (embedded VMs, game clients) 建立行为证据、检测逻辑和操作暴露面。
  • 优先关注：Enumerate the sandboxed environment、Direct command execution if io/os is exposed、Zero-click triggers via auto-run callbacks、Dangerous primitives to hunt during 侦察、Optional escalation: abusing Lua bytecode loaders；把命令、进程、文件、网络、注册表 / 日志事件映射到检测字段。
  • 区分正常管理行为与攻击行为，避免只按工具名告警；优先写可复现的查询条件。
  • OPSEC 记录应包括噪声来源、持久化痕迹、清理步骤和不可规避风险。
  • 本页已沉淀 5 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。

# 关键主题

  • Enumerate the sandboxed environment
  • Direct command execution if io/os is exposed
  • Zero-click triggers via auto-run callbacks
  • Dangerous primitives to hunt during 侦察
  • Optional escalation: abusing Lua bytecode loaders
  • 检测 and hardening notes (for defenders)

# 核心要点

  • Treat the VM as an unknown environment: enumerate G and discover what dangerous primitives are reachable.
  • If io/os is exposed, you often have direct command execution (io.popen, os.execute).
  • If load/loadstring/loadfile are exposed, executing crafted Lua bytecode can subvert memory safety in some versions (≤5.1 verifiers are bypassable; 5.2 removed verifier), enabling advanced 利用.
  • Generalize this pattern for your target: any textbox, toast, logger, or UI callback that accepts strings can act as stdout for 侦察.
  • Also check: package.loadlib (arbitrary DLL/.so loading), require with native modules, LuaJIT's ffi (if present), and the debug library (can raise privileges inside the VM).
  • If the host application pushes scripts to clients and the VM exposes auto-run hooks (e.g., OnInit/OnLoad/OnEnter), place your 载荷 there for drive-by compromise as soon as the script loads:
  • io, os: io.popen, os.execute, file I/O, env access.
  • load, loadstring, loadfile, dofile: execute source or bytecode; supports loading untrusted bytecode.
  • Lua ≤ 5.1 shipped a bytecode verifier that has known bypasses.
  • Lua 5.2 removed the verifier entirely (official stance: applications should just reject precompiled chunks), widening the attack surface if bytecode loading is not prohibited.
  • Workflows typically: leak pointers via in-VM output, craft bytecode to create type confusions (e.g., around FORLOOP or other opcodes), then pivot to arbitrary read/write or native code execution.
  • Server side: reject or rewrite user scripts; allowlist safe APIs; strip or bind-empty io, os, load/loadstring/loadfile/dofile, package.loadlib, debug, ffi.

# 核心要点

  • It's more and more common to find linux machines mounted with read-only (ro) file system protection, specially in containers. This is because to run a 容器 with ro file system is as easy as setting readOnlyRootFilesystem: true in the securitycontext:
  • <strong> readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
  • However, even if the file system is mounted as ro, /dev/shm will still be writable, so it's fake we cannot write anything in the disk. However, this folder will be mounted with no-exec protection, so if you 下载 a binary here you won't be able to execute it.
  • From a red team perspective, this makes complicated to 下载 and execute binaries that aren't in the system already (like backdoors o enumerators like kubectl).
  • Note that I mentioned binaries, you can execute any script as long as the interpreter is inside the machine, like a shell script if sh is present or a python script if python is installed.
  • However, this isn't just enough to execute your binary backdoor or other binary 工具 you might need to run.

  • The danger of 命令注入 is that it can allow an attacker to execute any command on the system, potentially leading to full system compromise.
  • Example of 命令注入 with PHP:
  • In the above code, the PHP script uses the system() function to execute the ping command with the IP address or domain provided by the user through the ip GET parameter.
  • If an attacker provides input like 8.8.8.8; cat /etc/passwd, the actual command that gets executed would be: ping -c 4 8.8.8.8; cat /etc/passwd.
  • ; (Semicolon): Allows you to execute multiple commands sequentially.
  • && (AND): Execute the second command only if the first command succeeds (returns a zero exit status).
  • || (OR): Execute the second command only if the first command fails (returns a non-zero exit status).
  • & (Background): Execute the command in the background, allowing the user to continue using the shell.
  • 命令注入 using backticks.
  • 命令注入 using substitution
  • In some shells, brace expansion generates arbitrary strings. When executed, the shell will treat the items inside the braces as separate commands or arguments.
  • Input redirection. The < character tells the shell to read the contents of the file specified.

# 核心要点

  • SQLmap is a powerful tool that automates the 检测 and 利用 of SQL 注入 vulnerabilities, saving time and effort compared to manual testing. It supports a wide range of databases and injection techniques, making it versatile and effective in various scenarios.
  • Additionally, SQLmap can retrieve data, manipulate databases, and even execute commands, providing a robust set of features for penetration testers and security analysts.
  • A request file in SQLmap is a saved HTTP request that SQLmap reads and uses to perform SQL 注入 testing. This file allows you to provide a complete and custom HTTP request, which SQLmap can use to target more complex applications.
  • A custom injection point in SQLmap allows you to specify exactly where and how SQLmap should attempt to inject 载荷 into a request. This is useful when dealing with more complex or non-standard injection scenarios that SQLmap may not detect automatically.
  • By defining a custom injection point with the wildcard character '*' , you have finer control over the testing process, ensuring SQLmap targets specific parts of the request you suspect to be vulnerable.
  • A second-order SQL 注入 occurs when malicious SQL code injected into an application is not executed immediately but is instead stored in the database and later used in another SQL query.
  • --suffix=SUFFIX: The --suffix option appends a specified string to the end of each 载荷 generated by SQLMap.
  • --prefix=PREFIX: The --prefix option prepends a specified string to the beginning of each 载荷 generated by SQLMap.
  • tamper (载荷): The main function that modifies the 载荷.
  • 令牌 generation: For handling CSRF tokens or dynamic auth headers.
  • The --technique argument defines which SQL 注入 methods sqlmap will attempt.
  • luanginxmore generates ~4.2M random POST parameters before your 载荷；use it only with --method=POST and expect large request sizes to crash poorly configured Lua-Nginx WAFs.
  • 利用 sqlmap 的合法功能完成 inherit 等操作；重点关注 sudo、SUID、受限 shell 与文件读写上下文。

  • To control the thread, thread suspend() is called, halting its execution.

  • ES EVENT TYPE NOTIFY THREAD SET STATE (added in macOS 14 Sonoma) – indicates register manipulation of an existing thread.

# 核心要点

  • The entitlement com.apple.rootless.install.heritable allows to 绕过 SIP. Check this for more info.
  • The entitlement com.apple.rootless.install allows to 绕过 SIP. Check this for more info.
  • This entitlement allows to load frameworks, plug-ins, or libraries without being either signed by Apple or signed with the same Team ID as the main executable, so an attacker could abuse some arbitrary library load to inject code. Check this for more info.
  • These entitlements allows to install software without asking for permissions to the user, which can be helpful for a 权限提升.
  • The entitlement com.apple.private.icloud-account-access it's possible to communicate with com.apple.iCloudHelper XPC service which will provide iCloud tokens.
  • Kernel attack surface via malformed IOConnectCallMethod calls

  • Purple-team loop & maturity metrics
  • Scenario templates
  • Scenario A – Flash-loan economic manipulation
  • Scenario B – Oracle/data-feed poisoning

# 核心要点

  • On-chain protocol logic handling lending, AMMs, vaults, staking, bridges, or settlement rails. Document the invariants they assume (oracle prices, collateral ratios, rebalance cadence…).
  • Translate the AADAPT taxonomy into concrete attack candidates per component.
  • Operational weaknesses: exposed CI 凭据，over-privileged IAM roles, misconfigured KMS policies, automation accounts that can request arbitrary signatures, public buckets with bridge configs, etc.
  • Value-specific weaknesses: fragile oracle parameters, upgradable contracts without multi-party approvals, flash-loan sensitive liquidity, governance actions that 绕过 timelocks.
  • Instrument telemetry streams so every scenario produces actionable 检测 data.
  • Chain-level traces: full call graphs, gas usage, transaction nonces, block timestamps—to reconstruct flash-loan bundles, reentrancy-like structures, and cross-contract hops.
  • Anomaly markers: derived metrics such as slippage spikes, abnormal collateralization ratios, unusual gas density, or cross-chain velocity.
  • Measurement: Do KMS/HSM logs raise anomaly alerts (time-of-day, destination drift, burst of high-risk operations)? Can policies or multisig thresholds prevent unilateral abuse? Are throttles/rate limits or additional approvals enforced?
  • Measurement: Time to correlate events across telemetry + commercial chain analytics, completeness of the reconstructed path, ability to identify choke points for freezing in a real incident, and alert fidelity for abnormal cross-chain velocity/value.

# 核心要点

  • Look for exported activities in the Android manifest (an activity with an intent-filter is exported by default). If an exported activity is protected by a permission, the attacking app will need the same permission, which limits exploitability.
  • Check the minimum SDK version android:minSdkVersion in AndroidManifest.xml. If it is lower than 30, older default behaviors may make tapjacking easier to 利用.
  • Trusted windows (accessibility, IME, assistant) still receive events. Invisible or fully transparent overlays also 绕过 the block, which attackers try to abuse by keeping alpha < 0.8.
  • Partial overlays that leave the target area visible are not auto-blocked. Mitigate in sensitive views by rejecting events with the FLAG WINDOW IS PARTIALLY OBSCURED flag:
  • The attribute setFilterTouchesWhenObscured set to true can also prevent the 利用 of this 漏洞 if the Android version is lower.\
  • The most recent Android application performing a Tapjacking attack (+ invoking before an exported activity of the attacked application) can be found in: https://github.com/carlospolop/Tapjacking-ExportedActivity.
  • Hidden-VNC banking RATs briefly display phishing overlays to capture 凭据，then rely on covert VNC plus Accessibility to replay taps with fewer on-device artifacts.
  • 下载 an HTML/JS overlay template from the C2 that perfectly imitates that specific application (Logo, colours, i18n strings…).
  • Display the overlay, harvest 凭据 / PIN/pattern.
  • Audit the list of installed apps with adb shell pm list packages -3 -e BIND ACCESSIBILITY SERVICE.

# 核心要点

  • Key idea: encode structural impossibilities and cross‑field inconsistencies that only appear when a vulnerable decoder/parser state is reached.
  • When weaponized samples are unavailable and 载荷 bytes mutate, traditional IOC/YARA patterns fail. Structural 检测 inspects the 容器’s declared layout versus what is mathematically or semantically possible for the format implementation.
  • Detect contradictory fields that indicate parser confusion or 整数溢出 set‑ups
  • Works without embedded 载荷 signatures
  • Total size of constructed Huffman tables exceeds the safe upper bound expected by the reference/patched implementations, implying the overflow precondition.
  • Robust against byte‑level polymorphism of the 载荷
  • Presence of undocumented/forbidden opcodes in Apple’s interpreter used by the 利用 chain.
  • Dump font tables (e.g., using fontTools/ttx) and scan fpgm/prep/glyf programs
  • Reported exploited in the wild; excellent candidate for structural consistency checks
  • dd if=sample.dng of = 载荷.zip bs=1 skip="$off"
  • zipdetails -v 载荷.zip; unzip -l 载荷.zip
  • Exploited in the wild against Samsung’s libimagecodec.quram.so (CVE‑2025‑21042). The appended ZIP contained native modules (e.g., loader + SELinux policy editor) extracted/executed post‑RCE.
  • Auto‑detect file type and dispatch only relevant analyzers (PDF/JBIG2, WebP/VP8L, TTF, DNG/TIFF, HEIF/AVIF)
  • Run analyses in parallel (thread‑pool) for bulk triage
